modes.provider-alias: Orca-managed provider path links back to the canonical root.
modes.explicit-path: Task instructs the worker to read exact SKILL.md paths.
modes.inline-extract: Coordinator includes only necessary skill sections and records source/hash.

codex.evidence: codex.exe contains the '.agents/skills' lookup string; `orca skills installed` publishes to the 'codex' provider.

agent-skills-home.evidence: `orca skills installed` reports provider 'agent-skills' for this home; the coordinator session reads this root directly.

claude.observed: The claimed path does not exist on this host; `orca skills installed` lists no 'claude' provider (only 'agent-skills' and 'codex'); claude.exe contains '.agents/skills'.

registryAlignment: agents/registry.json records explicit-path for claude and claude-agent-teams as of 2026-10-02; this file is the authority when the two disagree (see SKILL.md 'Skill delivery').

defaultForOtherAgents.policy: Do not assume native discovery until current provider behavior is verified on this host. A skill name appearing in a Task is not evidence that the worker loaded it.
